The '''reporter''' was a journalist who worked for the [[Galaxy News Network]] in [[Timeline (2050-2099)#2077|2077]]. 

==Background==
This journalist was assigned to commentate on the public unveiling of [[Vault 33]] which occurred a week after the [[Battle of Anchorage|U.S. victory at Anchorage]] on January 10, 2077. As a journalist, he was not used to the type of improvisation needed by live television anchors and was more used to reporting news stories as they were given. Though the broadcast initially went well, the journalist found it increasingly difficult to perform his job because of technical difficulties and his incompetent intern assistant [[Arnold (Galaxy News Network)|Arnold]], and he spiralled into hysteria and gloom over the of the modern world.<ref name="0:">''[[Fallout - A Special LIVE Report from Galaxy News]]''</ref>

As the coverage continued, the reporter, much to his dismay, would learn that he would share a [[Vault]] together with Arnold. However, over time, the reporter accepted this and hoped the tour would soon begin.<ref name="0:" />

==Appearances==
The reporter appears only in the ''[[Fallout - A Special LIVE Report from Galaxy News]]''.
